visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit, modern kitchen with white cabinets and wooden countertops. Three young women with long dark hair, dressed in matching white t-shirts and denim, are happily engaged in cooking activities. One woman on the left whisks a bowl, another in the center stirs a frying pan on an induction cooktop, and the third on the right watches and laughs. The environment is clean and staged with kitchen utensils and plants. (2) The scene shifts to the dining area where the women are eating sandwiches and strawberries. They lean in together to take a group selfie with a smartphone, exhibiting wide smiles and playful poses. The lighting is soft and warm, highlighting their joyful interactions. (3) The mood changes to a reality-check scenario. One woman stands in a living room, holding a phone and looking frustrated while talking to her roommate who is seated. The lighting remains bright, but the body language is more tense and argumentative. (4) The women are shown in a montage of household chores: cleaning windows, sweeping, and holding a trash bag while smiling exaggeratedly for the camera. Yellow and pink text overlays appear at the top. (5) In a realistic turn, one woman is seen struggling with a heavy, overflowing trash bag and a blue plastic bin. She looks annoyed and points toward her roommates who are preoccupied with their phones on the sofa, ignoring the mess. (6) The three women are seated on a light-colored sofa in front of a television showing a medical drama. They react with exaggerated expressions of shock and excitement, pointing at the screen and laughing together. (7) One woman holds a silver Apple MacBook laptop while the others sit nearby with smartphones. The atmosphere becomes frustrated again as they point at their devices, indicating a slow internet connection. (8) The final sequence is a high-energy promotional segment. The women are seen happily using their devices (laptop and phones) with smooth connectivity. A yellow plush duck keychain with a 'Taiwan Mobile' logo is shown in a close-up, hanging from a leopard print bag. The video ends with a group shot where they look satisfied and give thumbs-up gestures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-frequency, upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat. Three female voices are heard laughing and talking with high arousal and bright, energetic tones, overlapping significantly. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition into dialogue. One female voice becomes more assertive and slightly annoyed, with rapid speech and rising intonations as she questions her roommate. (3) A loud rustling of plastic followed by a dull 'thud' of an object hitting the floor marks a new phase. Voices are high-pitched, expressing frustration and disgust through exaggerated vocal fry and sharp articulations. (4) The BGM continues steadily as a new, professional male voice with a clear, calm broadcast quality enters to narrate technical details. His speech is enunciated and well-projected over the music bed. (5) Several high-pitched digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects occur in quick succession, synchronized with visual text appearing. The female voices return in the background, now cheering with positive valence and high pitch. (6) The video concludes with a harmonic chord swell from the BGM and a final crisp 'ding' sound, accompanied by laughing and supportive vocalizations in Japanese ('Sou desu ne') and Chinese.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable 'Dream vs. Reality' comedic trope regarding roommates living together to highlight the frustrations of slow internet and chores. It transitions into a promotion for Taiwan Mobile's high-speed 5G and Wi-Fi 6 plans, presenting the service as the solution to household harmony and seamless entertainment.
